implementation_delta: Native controls after the stopped v10r canary (#2010, #2013, #2014, #2018, #2023, #2026, #2029, #2031–#2033, #2036–#2039, #2041; PR #2017, the base of this registration): a registered 10800 s attempt deadline; a stopped receipt that states whether the transcript reached its result line; every controller stop recorded in the ledger, the deadline under the proxy state lock before admission closes; playbook guidance to double-quote receipt snippets and reasons and to read a file before rewriting it; and controller enforcement of the maintainer ruling of 2026-09-17: every permission denial the runtime result line records is listed with its classification, each command read as bash reads it, on a completed or a stopped attempt; a denied prescribed command, or a denial record the controller cannot classify, disqualifies; a receipt whose transcript holds no single result line says it classified nothing; unusable evidence inputs fail validation, and every stop is named with its source (#2031–#2033, #2036–#2039). Carried from v10r (#1914–#1916, #1918, #1922–#2009): stop reason on the controller receipt with the traceback kept beside it, the observer refusal model, the allowlist roster tested against the playbook, the prescribed-commands-only shell rule, Phase 1 receipt-per-chunk with the file tool and the receipts-check gate before Phase 2. No per-attempt cap on the agentic arm, by user direction (#1917); API caps unchanged. Renderers, evidence protocol, source-review instrument, prompts, sources, schemas and profiles unchanged from v10r.
